summary: Added a deterministic backend journey harness covering registration-to-publication, request ownership and state transitions, advertising/payment-proof boundaries, commission resolution, and guaranteed cleanup. Route steps are checked against the executable runtime inventory; ads and commissions remain explicitly service-level until HTTP routes exist.

verification.notes: 4 journey tests passed, including route-inventory validation, ordered execution, failure cleanup, and real in-memory ads/payment/commission service boundaries.
Contracts and API TypeScript checks passed.
Repository lint passed with zero warnings.
Workspace, contracts, and API builds passed.
Deterministic implemented runtime inventory generated successfully.
Synthetic test environment validated; no real environment file or credential was read.
22 integration checks passed, including the journey suite.

knownGaps: The registration/publication/request portion is a deterministic synthetic executor because no isolated live MongoDB dataset or external account credentials are available; route paths are still validated against the executable runtime inventory.
Ads and commissions have service-level implementations but no dedicated HTTP routes, so the journey does not invent or claim unavailable endpoints.
Live MongoDB, external storage/scanning, payment-provider, and production-account execution remains an optional isolated-environment check.
The repository declares Node 24-25 while this verification environment runs Node 22.18.0.
